structured.approach: FE-01 checks only whether the repository is available and writable, so I did the checks directly instead of handing them to a helper. I read both inputs (feat.tasks, org.engineering_stack) to find the Frontend lane's task and repository: TSK-07 in ap_portal. FE-01 blocks shell commands (the G9 hook refused git), so I took availability, branch, clean tree and write access from the step's tool view. I backed those up by reading the repository files: .git/HEAD, the branch logs for feature/story, dev and main, package.json, ci.mjs and the VERSION and exports lines in index.js. I used Glob to confirm that every file in TSK-07's budget already exists. An earlier draft was at the output path. It cited org.engineering_stack at commit b6a392f, but this step received commit 76d03ce, so I replaced the whole file with grounded content. I kept personal data from the git logs and the remote URL out of the output (G8). I needed no connectors.
tools_used: Bash (blocked by G9 hook; no command ran)

claims.text: The Frontend lane owns one task, TSK-07 (STORY-07), in the ap_portal repository; it depends only on the CT-1 field list, not on TSK-06 code.
Repository ap_portal is available locally; no repository creation is needed.
The working branch feature/story is checked out and was created from dev at commit ff761ee; local dev and main point to the same commit.
The agent identity has write access and the working tree is clean.
No Databricks workspace or database is used by ap_portal.
ap_portal is Node.js 22 CommonJS with node:test; CI is `node ci.mjs` and enforces line coverage >= 90 plus static checks (no console.log or eval(, lines at most 140 characters).
Current version is 2.3.0 in both src/ap_portal/index.js (VERSION) and package.json; current exports are VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount, renderAgingSummary.
All files in TSK-07's budget (src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json, tests/portal.test.js) already exist in the checkout.
Commit messages start with the story ID (STORY-07); the task ID may follow.

open_questions: RAQ-1 (non-blocking): feat.tasks and ap_portal/CLAUDE.md name the branch pattern feature/<story>, but the branch provided is feature/story rather than feature/STORY-07. Interim answer: work on feature/story as the spine provided; commits carry STORY-07. Owner: Developer.
structured.summary: ap_portal, the only repository the Frontend lane needs (TSK-07 / STORY-07), is available locally and the agent has write access. Branch feature/story is checked out from dev at ff761ee, the working tree is clean, and no repository creation, Databricks or database is needed. The output also records the CI binding (node ci.mjs, coverage >= 90), the current version 2.3.0 and that all three files TSK-07 will change exist. One non-blocking question remains about the generic branch name. task.repo_access.md replaces the earlier draft, which cited an older org.engineering_stack commit.

tool_input.command: git branch -a && git status --short --branch && git log --oneline -3 --all && git remote -v && ls -la . src/ap_portal tests && test -w . && echo WRITABLE && grep -n "VERSION\s*=" src/ap_portal/index.js; grep -n '"version"' package.json; node --version
tool_input.description: Inspect ap_portal branches, status, write access and versions

tool_input.command: git branch && git status --short --branch && git log --oneline -3
tool_input.description: Show ap_portal branches, status and recent commits
